title: Mate: Free the rest of the runtime data
description:
Don't change the configuration data in the runtime. Instead, keep all
the runtime data in the runtime struct, and access the configuration
data through const pointers. This is cleaner and also would make it
easier to switch the memory management to wmem later.

commits_data.message:
Mate: Free the rest of the runtime data

Don't change the configuration data in the runtime. Instead, keep all
the runtime data in the runtime struct, and access the configuration
data through const pointers. This is cleaner and also would make it
easier to switch the memory management to wmem later.
